# Getting help

1. **Open FW Block on the TV first.**  The main screen says, in plain words, whether firmware updates are blocked, what's still open, and which button fixes it.
2. **The [README](https://github.com/ohmybahgosh/WEBOS-FW-BLOCK#readme)** covers installing, what it blocks, and using the script over SSH.
3. **A question?**  Ask in [Discussions > Q&A](https://github.com/ohmybahgosh/WEBOS-FW-BLOCK/discussions/new?category=q-a).
4. **Found a bug?**  Open a [bug report](https://github.com/ohmybahgosh/WEBOS-FW-BLOCK/issues/new?template=bug-report.yml) with the app's **Help and report** (or `sh fw-block.sh report`).
5. **Tried it on your TV?**  A [TV report](https://github.com/ohmybahgosh/WEBOS-FW-BLOCK/issues/new?template=tv-report.yml) helps, whether it worked or not.
6. **An idea?**  Post it in [Discussions > Ideas](https://github.com/ohmybahgosh/WEBOS-FW-BLOCK/discussions/new?category=ideas).

Rooting the TV isn't covered here: see [cani.rootmy.tv](https://cani.rootmy.tv/) and the [webOS Homebrew project](https://www.webosbrew.org/).  Security problems go through [private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/ohmybahgosh/WEBOS-FW-BLOCK/security/advisories/new), never a public issue.
